XAUUSD weekly review, 23-27 Nov. Gold rose about 76 points (about 2%), open 3576 to close 3652. High 3690 Monday, low 3427 Wednesday, then a strong rebound. Friday was rejected near 3685. Short term is up, above the 1H EMA 20 and 50. The daily trend is still down.
Resistance: 3672-3690, then 3720 (broken support). Support: 3605-3621, then 3547-3559.
BUY zone: 3605-3621. SELL zone: 3672-3690.
Big US news:
Tue ISM Manufacturing 17:00 Beirut / 19:00 Dubai / 16:00 Vienna.
Thu ISM Services 17:00 Beirut / 19:00 Dubai / 16:00 Vienna.
Fri jobs report (NFP) 15:30 Beirut / 17:30 Dubai / 14:30 Vienna.
